feature-approval-required: Puritia ngā āheinga ka tāpirihia e ngā whakahōunga WeKan kia monokia kia whakahohea rā anō e tētahi kaiwhakahaere
feature-awaiting-approval: (hou, e tatari ana ki te whakaaetanga)
feature-board-summary-desc: Tahua papa → Ka whakaatu te Whakarāpopototanga i ngā mahi a ia tangata i te papa i te rā, i te wiki whakamutunga rānei, me ngā mea kua tōmuri.
feature-pilot-users: Ngā kaiwhakamahi whakamātau ka kite hoki i ngā āheinga kua monokia
feature-pilot-users-placeholder: Ngā ingoa kaiwhakamahi, wehea ki te piko
feature-pilot-users-unknown: Kua tiakina. Kāore ēnei ingoa kaiwhakamahi i kitea:
feature-preview-admins: Ka kite ngā kaiwhakahaere i ngā āheinga kua monokia kia whakamātauria i te tuatahi
feature-rule-suggestions-desc: Tahua papa → Ka marohi ngā Ture i ngā ture mai i ngā mea e mahia ana ā-ringa e te tangata i ia wā.
feature-search-phrases-desc: Ka mārama te rapu whānui ki ngā kīanga māmā pērā i "aku kāri kua tōmuri".
feature-since-last-visit-desc: Tahua papa → Ka whakaatu a Mai i tō toronga whakamutunga i ngā mea i hurihia e ētahi atu i te papa.
feature-views-calendar-desc: Te maramataka me te maramataka mō ngā papa maha.
feature-views-chat-desc: Ko te papa hei wāhi kōrerorero: ngā wāhi mahi, ngā papa, ngā ara, ngā rārangi me ngā kāri hei rākau hongere, ko te kāri kei waenganui, ā, ko ōna kōrero hei karere kōrerorero.
feature-views-column-sets-desc: Ko ngā kāri ōrite i ētahi huinga tīwae whai ingoa - mā te otinga, te matua, te tohu taumata, tētahi atu mea rānei - ka nekehia i waenga i ngā tīwae mā te tō.
feature-views-email-desc: Ko te papa hei pouaka īmēra: ko te rārangi īmēra te Pouaka whakauru, ko ngā rārangi ngā kōpaki, ko ngā tapanga ngā tapanga, ā, ka tuhi, ka whakautu ngā mema i ngā īmēra mai i te wāhitau o te papa.
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Te mahi e toe ana, te mahi kua oti, te rerenga whakaemi, te wā huringa me te wā mai i te tono ki te otinga, te nui o ngā mahi kua oti, te roanga kua tatari ngā mahi, ngā ārai, Monte Carlo me ērā atu inenga rerenga.
feature-views-gantt-desc: Ngā tirohanga tūtohi Gantt e toru.
feature-views-map-desc: Ngā kāri hei tohu i runga i tētahi atahanga kua tukuatu.
feature-views-overview-desc: Ngā tatauranga, te whakarōpū mā te tangata kua tohua, te mahere mahi, te papatohu me te papa nui.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Ngā mahi hua e tārewa ana, ngā wāmahi poto, te pūrongo wāmahi me te tere mahi.
feature-views-table-desc: Te papa hei ripanga kāri ka taea te kōmaka.
feature-views-time-desc: Te wā me te rārangi wā.
feature-views-version-control-desc: Te poari hei kaiaroturuki take GitHub, Gitea rānei: ngā kāri hei take, ngā tapanga me ngā pou tohu, ngā kōrero hei kōrerorero, ngā āpitihanga hei kōnae, me te hītori o te poari me te wetewete.

home-board-empty: Tōia kia kotahi anake te papa ki konei kia huakina i muri i te takiuru
home-board-remove-confirm: Tangohia tēnei papa mai i te Kāinga? Kāore te papa ake e mukua.

select-only-one-board: Tīpakohia koa kia kotahi anake te papa

set-selected-unstarred: Tangohia te whetū i ngā papa kua tīpakohia
